text_config.architecture: SimplCore SGC + Qwen3 FFN (TS2SC direct migration)

vision_merger.note: output dim equals text hidden_size — no random projection added

known_limitations: MiniCPM-V 4.7 vocab 248094 vs Qwen3 151936: image/slice special token ids (248056 etc.) exceed the text vocab; remap or extend embedding before multimodal inference.
MiniCPM-V 4.7 uses mrope/canvas while Qwen3 uses standard RoPE; position scheme is not unified.
No cross-modal alignment training has been performed: the package is a weight-level merge, NOT a usable VQA model.
Static average-attention kernel ceiling measured at cos 0.3695 (TS2SC_V3/profile_ceiling.json): pairwise content addressing is a hard gap that no input-independent kernel can close.
Readout alignment W and analytic v3 kernel transfer were both tested and rejected (repetition loops); only DC-bias is applied in v2.
DC-bias reduces repetition (rep3 0.6429 -> 0.2143 on '中国的首都是') but does NOT fix factual errors, base-model continuation behaviour, or the pairwise gap.
